categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily focuses on the research, development, and manufacturing of honeycomb ceramic products used in air pollution control, especially for automotive exhaust treatment. Its main products include straight-through carriers (DOC, SCR, ASC, TWC), wall-flow carriers (DPF, ACT-DPF, SiC-DPF, GPF), non-road and marine engine carriers, and energy-saving regenerative bodies. It also engages in emerging energy technologies such as hydrogen energy and thermal acoustic refrigeration through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include proprietary synthesis and crystal growth control of cordierite materials and high-performance honeycomb ceramic carrier preparation processes. The company integrates formula design, precision mold manufacturing, and kiln firing temperature control to produce low thermal expansion, thin-walled, high-porosity ceramic carriers. It also develops silicon carbide DPFs and ultra-high porosity ceramics for new applications. Production involves complex multi-step processes with strict quality control and automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are catalyst coating manufacturers supplying automotive OEMs, especially in the heavy-duty diesel truck segment. The company serves domestic and international markets, including the US, Canada, South Korea, and India, focusing on heavy trucks, non-road mobile machinery, and marine engines. It is expanding into passenger vehicle markets and emerging energy sectors like fuel cells and hydrogen energy.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shandong, Chongqing, Anhui, and Jiangxi provinces. It has established overseas sales and service networks targeting North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific regions. Export markets include the US, Canada, South Korea, and India. The company is actively expanding its global footprint through direct sales and vendor-managed inventory models.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing core ceramic substrates for automotive and industrial exhaust after-treatment systems. It supplies these substrates to catalyst coating companies and system integrators who then supply OEMs and aftermarket customers. It also engages in upstream R&D and downstream sales and technical support.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing honeycomb ceramic technology to meet increasingly stringent emission standards (China VI, Euro 6, and upcoming Euro 7). The company invests in ultra-low NOx emission technologies, ultra-thin wall carriers, and high-efficiency particulate filters. It is developing new materials and applications in hydrogen energy, thermal acoustic refrigeration, and multi-porous ceramics. R&D emphasizes innovation, patent acquisition, and collaboration with top universities and research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of honeycomb ceramic substrates and related products to domestic and international customers. Sales are conducted via direct sales channels, including order-based domestic sales and export sales through VMI and non-VMI models. The company also earns income from government subsidies, investment income, and other operating revenues.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the honeycomb ceramic substrate industry, especially in large-size substrates for heavy-duty diesel vehicles. It competes against global oligopolies such as Corning (USA) and NGK (Japan), which dominate over 90% of the global market. The company has broken domestic reliance on foreign technology and is recognized as a national high-tech and specialized 'little giant' enterprise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 284 million, a 14.46% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 44 million. The company’s total assets were about RMB 1.19 billion, with net assets around RMB 858 million. Despite recent losses, the company maintains significant R&D investment (7.71% of revenue) and is expanding production capacity and market reach.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary cordierite crystal growth and ceramic formulation technologies that yield ultra-low thermal expansion, high durability, and superior filtration efficiency. Its integrated formula-mold-kiln process ensures high product quality and cost efficiency. The company’s large-size honeycomb ceramic substrates meet stringent emission standards and break foreign monopolies, offering customers reliable, domestically produced, and technologically advanced products. It also differentiates through its expanding portfolio in emerging energy sectors.
